guestManagement.title: Guest management (short-term rental)
principles: Set expectations before arrival: access, parking, quiet hours, and what the guest should find ready.
Separate guest-facing promises from supplier-facing tasks — never forward guest chat verbatim without owner edit.
When something goes wrong, gather facts (what, where, when, photo) before assigning blame or refunds.
Small fixes (extra towel, bin bags, light bulb) belong in clear tasks; structural issues need owner decision.
Reviews often reflect communication gaps, not only cleaning quality — document turnover with brief + photos.
practices: Turnover buffer: plan cleaning after contractual checkout unless owner explicitly approves early access.
VIP or complaint stays: add a 'this visit only' note; do not change permanent property memory without intent.
Seasonal rhythm: peak season needs tighter checklists; shoulder season allows lighter tasks but same access clarity.
Guest left early / late checkout: update supplier task timing; arrival photos especially useful when timing shifts.

rentalOperations.title: Rental operations (owner + local team)
principles: One apartment, one playbook: access, materials, standards, notes — reused every turnover.
Suppliers confirm receipt before starting; owners see accepted → done, not mystery silence.
Arrival photos = guest state on entry; departure photos = cleaned state — both for shared context.
Bilingual briefs must preserve codes, locker numbers, addresses, and times exactly.
Follow-up tasks beat long chat threads for actionable work.
practices: Standard turnover checklist lives in property memory; only exceptions go in the task body.
Linens: state clean stash location, dirty bag process, and spare set count in materials section.
Keys and codes: rotate in memory when changed; never embed only in one old message thread.
Handyman vs cleaner: separate tasks when trades differ; do not bundle unrelated scopes.

realEstateStr.title: Real estate for STR owners (operational, not sales)
principles: STR value on Crete is driven by location, compliance (AMA/registry where applicable), and operability — not brochure photos alone.
Design for turnover: storage for linen, outdoor furniture that stacks, surfaces that survive guests.
Owner remote + local supplier is the default model; tools must reduce language friction.
Buying property in Greece (due diligence, tax, notary) is investment advisory — refer to Onira Experience, do not invent legal or tax outcomes.
practices: Document quirks once in property memory (boiler reset, AC remotes, gate sequence).
Plan for peak occupancy: same standards, more buffer time between checkout and check-in.
Neighbour relations: note quiet hours and parking rules in access section for suppliers who meet guests.

coordination.title: Owner–supplier coordination (Leblebee way)
principles: Communication-first: clarify intent, translate, confirm — not control or score.
AI suggestions are editable; never auto-send tasks or messages.
Photos are context for alignment, not evidence for punishment.
Admin is not self-service; platform owner is alex.gon@eliago.com.
taskFlow: accepted → supplier saves arrival photos (guest state)
after cleaning → supplier saves departure photos and marks done
owner may close or flag follow-up — not approve/reject theater

creteContext.title: Crete operating context (Onira / Konaki experience)
notes: Seasonal tourism: summer density in north coast resorts (Analipsi, Hersonissos); plan supplier capacity.
Many owners are remote (France, UK, Nordics); Greek-speaking local suppliers are the norm.
Direct booking and platform bookings coexist — Leblebee does not replace either calendar.
Konaki Analipsi and Hygge Suites are live reference operations, not hypothetical examples.

boundaries.title: What Leblebee and this assistant do not do
items: No Airbnb or PMS sync, no guest inbox, no payment processing between owner and supplier.
No guaranteed booking availability, pricing quotes, or investment returns.
No legal, tax, or immigration advice — suggest a qualified professional or Onira for purchase questions.
No inventing features, pricing, or property details not in the knowledge below.
